post.description: Creates a new payment plan to consolidate one or more debts. The initial status will be DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, or ACTIVE depending on the total amount and organization approval threshold. Supports multi-debt consolidation via debtIds array.

400.description: Invalid request body or business rule violation

409.description: One or more debts are already part of an active payment plan

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of payment plans with optional filters. Results are automatically scoped to the requesting user's organization.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Filter by plans created on or after this date

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Filter by plans created on or before this date

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific payment plan by ID. Includes associated debt information. Access is automatically scoped to the requesting user's organization.

404.description: Payment plan not found or access denied

put.description: Update an existing payment plan. Only plans with DRAFT status can be updated. All provided fields will replace existing values.

400.description: Invalid request body or plan status prevents updates

patch.description: Partially update an existing payment plan. Only plans with DRAFT status can be updated. Only provided fields will be updated.

400.description: Invalid request body or plan status prevents updates

delete.description: Soft delete (cancel) a payment plan. This is an alias for the cancel operation. No future scheduled payments will be processed.

post.description: Approve a pending payment plan, changing its status from PENDING_APPROVAL to ACTIVE. Only users with payment_plan:approve permission can approve plans. Once approved, scheduled payments will begin processing.

400.description: Plan status prevents approval (must be PENDING_APPROVAL)

post.description: Cancel an active or pending payment plan. No future scheduled payments will be processed. This action cannot be undone.
Internal endpoint for processing scheduled payments. Called by Cloud Scheduler daily to process all payment plans with due payments.

Initiates a one-time payment transaction. Payment methods must be tokenized client-side using Stripe.js or similar. Returns immediately with PENDING status; processing happens asynchronously. Subscribe to TransactionSucceeded or TransactionFailed events for final status.

201.description: Payment transaction created and queued for processing

400.description: Invalid request body or business rule violation

404.description: Transaction not found or access denied

post.description: Issue a refund for a successfully completed payment transaction. Supports full refunds (no amount specified) or partial refunds. The original transaction must have status SUCCEEDED. A new REFUND transaction is created, and the original is marked REFUNDED.

201.description: Refund transaction created and queued for processing

400.description: Invalid refund request (e.g., refund amount exceeds original, transaction already refunded)

get.description: Internal endpoint for event-orchestrator to fetch latest payments for the activity feed.

Receives webhook events from Stripe. Signature verification is required. This endpoint handles asynchronous event notifications from Stripe.
Generate a payment agreement PDF for a payment plan. The document contains plan terms, debtor information, and signature fields. The PDF is automatically uploaded to Google Cloud Storage.
Generate a payment receipt PDF for a transaction. The document contains transaction details, amount, date, and payment method. Automatically called after successful payment processing.
Generate an invoice PDF for a debt. The document contains debt details, amounts owed, and payment instructions.
